primitives.label: Shell
primitives.when: Reach for Shell when a surface needs the object-centric page frame before any primitive renders inside it.

primitives.label: Collection
primitives.when: Reach for Collection when the user needs to scan many rows of one object — it renders the model's fields as columns with model-toned status badges.

primitives.label: Record
primitives.when: Reach for Record when one row is in focus — it renders every field of a single row plus its association targets.

primitives.label: Write
primitives.when: Reach for Write when the user changes data — it derives a form and in-place editors from the model's field types.

primitives.label: Query
primitives.when: Reach for Query when the user filters or searches across an object's rows — it derives filter controls from the model's fields and statuses.

primitives.label: Traversal
primitives.when: Reach for Traversal when the user walks associations between objects — it follows the model's association declarations, null-guarding unregistered targets.

regions.owns: mode switching — one icon button per workspace mode, aria-pressed marks the active mode
regions.rule: The rail is fixed-width and never hosts panels; it only changes which mode owns the navigator and canvas.

regions.owns: mode-owned navigation — grouped trees with counts for object modes, canned queries for query mode, association walking for traversal mode
regions.rule: The navigator is a resizable region (DS Resizable panel); its contents are a function of the active mode, never hardcoded per object.

regions.owns: the primary view panel — an anonymous workspace-panel hosting the mode's views (tab strip when more than one)
regions.rule: The canvas has no dedicated data-slot; it hosts an anonymous workspace-panel (panels-are-anonymous-slots), located as the panel outside workspace-dock. It is a resizable region.

regions.owns: zero or more panels — the default inspector is just a panel; users can pin additional frozen panels
regions.rule: The dock is a resizable region holding an array of anonymous panels; multiplicity is allowed and every panel is closable.

rules.statement: A workspace view is a pure function of WorkspaceContext ({ model, rows, selectedId, select }); views never own object-specific state.
A panel is an anonymous slot that hosts any array of views with a tab strip when more than one; nothing about a panel is object-specific.
The inspector is not a special region — it is just a panel in the dock, replaceable and composable like any other.
The dock holds an array of panels; pinning clones the current context into a frozen panel while the live inspector keeps following selection.
Navigator, canvas, and dock are resizable regions hosted in the DS Resizable component; the activity rail is fixed.
Status rendering derives from the model's declared StatusTone via toneToStatus (active maps to booked, never pending); no surface hardcodes per-object status switches.
Exactly one tone-to-Status map exists, in lib/objects/status-map.ts; check-status-map.mjs fails the build if another file defines one.
Files under lib/objects/ never import from components/; React may appear only in dedicated hook files (use-*.ts), keeping the object model UI-agnostic.
All object registration flows through registerObject(model, rows); no component mutates objectRegistry or objectRowsRegistry directly.
